violations.description: General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Nonfood contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in a good repair or sound condition. -Drain line of 2 door cooler is loose from drain pan, using cloth to catch condensation until fixed.

Water Supply. — --Nonpublic water supply was not tested by EPA-certified laboratory annually for nitrate analysis. -Current documentation of water samples unavailable at time of inspection.--Nonpublic water supply was not tested by EPA-certified laboratory monthly for bacteriological analysis. -Current documentation of water samples unavailable at time of inspection.

Storage of personal care items, medicines, and first aid supplies. — --Personal care item, first aid supply or medicine was not stored in a manner to protect against contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single-service items. -Pine Sol, no-rinse sanitizer, and other chemicals stored in bottom of cabinet commingling with syrup, canned food, and box of gloves.
General employee cleanliness. — --Food employee did not wash hands as necessary. -Staff put on gloves without washing hands first (to reach in and turn ice cream machine).
Water Supply. — --Nonpublic water supply was not tested by EPA-certified laboratory monthly for bacteriological analysis. -Last bacterial sample conducted 04/18/2025.
Cleaning frequency, maintained clean (1 pt deducted)
